g.text: Down Home Creole · Phase 1 prototype · 1,000 lb/week, 5 blends (13-blend ready)

svg.text: 1. Rates from design/out/line-balance.json and dosing-plan.json; 1,000 lb/week on 5 days, 1 shift.
2. 9 bins dosed automatically (82.5 % of blend weight); lines under 4 kg are hand-weighed, under 2 % go to premix.
3. CCP-1 is metal detection of the finished pack (P1-406). Sieve and magnets are prerequisite programs.
4. MES links ingredient lots > bin (every lot since last empty) > batch > drum > unit lot code > case > pallet.
5. Grinding is optional at launch: the bins accept bought ground spice; the mill takes whole peppercorns in house.
6. Seasonings only in Phase 1: no wheat on site, so the gluten-free claim is protected by separation.
